column1: Feng Wei is a 'Jack of all trades, master of none' character who delivers extremely well when it comes down to poking at small distances with his jab strings "1,3", "1,2", "1,1", a pseudo-homing mid "B+4" and a i14 "DF+1". Combining this with the evasive moveset of Feng makes him a unique blend of evasive offense. The whole of his gameplan revolves around instigating the opponent to retaliate into his poking, after which Feng can retaliate back with his fast Counter-hit tools like "B+1", "1,1", "UF+2", highly rewarding parries like "F+1+2", and Back Kenpo "B+3+4" evasion. Even though Feng might look too good on paper, he is extremely balanced and has to take risks against defensive players, be it by dashing or by choosing risky pokes like "DB+3" to keep the offense.

Feng is extremely beginner-friendly. He is a fundamental-based character with enough specific scenario-based options that can be handy in a lot of matchups (i.g Nina/Anna). If you're a fan of keeping up the high pace and high awareness in split-second decisions
column2: this character is built for you.
